description: Source file implementing internal usage and help message handling for Abseil flags, including printing help messages, managing help modes, and handling command-line flags related to usage.

classes.name: XMLElement
classes.description: Helper class to generate XML elements with proper escaping of special characters.

classes.name: FlagHelpPrettyPrinter
classes.description: Helper class to format help messages with line wrapping and indentation.

methods.name: FlagHelpHumanReadable
methods.description: Outputs help information for a command line flag in human-readable format.

methods.name: FlagsHelpImpl
methods.description: Internal implementation to output help messages for flags, either in human-readable or XML format.

methods.name: FlagHelp
methods.description: Public API to output help for a specific flag.

methods.name: FlagsHelp
methods.description: Public API to output help for all flags matching a filter.

methods.name: HandleUsageFlags
methods.description: Handles command-line flags related to usage/help and outputs appropriate help messages.

methods.name: GetFlagsHelpMatchSubstr
methods.description: Retrieves the current substring filter for help matching.

methods.name: SetFlagsHelpMatchSubstr
methods.description: Sets the substring filter for help matching.

methods.description: Deduces and sets help-related flags based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: MaybeExit
methods.description: Exits the program based on the current help mode.
